found_specs.title: Architecture & Technical Specification (CLAUDE.md) - Complete system architecture, auth flow, OAuth 2.0 provider spec, database schema, route structure, server actions, environment variables, CI/CD backup workflow
Application Blueprint (blueprint.md) - Core features specification: Discord Auth, Member Profile Management, Team Management, Generation Role Management, Admin Dashboard, Safe Deletion
OAuth 2.0 Utility Implementation - JWT token generation/verification (HS256), PKCE S256 verification, client secret hashing (bcrypt), token expiry constants, redirect URI validation
OAuth 2.0 Authorization Endpoint - Parameter validation, Supabase auth check, client verification via RPC, consent history lookup, redirect to consent page
OAuth 2.0 Token Endpoint - Authorization code exchange, client secret verification, PKCE validation, JWT access token generation, code deletion after use
OAuth 2.0 UserInfo Endpoint - Bearer token validation, JWT verification, returns user claims (sub, display_name, discord_id, generation, status)
OAuth Consent Actions - Server action creating authorization code in DB upon user consent approval
Supabase Client Configuration - Cookie-based SSR client (RLS) and Admin client (RLS bypass via service_role key), member schema hardcoded
Supabase Auth Middleware - Session management, cookie refresh, route protection
Next.js Middleware - Routes all non-static requests through Supabase session updater
TypeScript Type Definitions - Member, Team, MemberTeamRelation, TeamLeader, GenerationRole, MemberWithTeams, FullUserProfile, DiscordMemberStatus
Member Server Actions - Registration, profile update, admin member management, Discord bot sync (role sync, nickname update)
Team Server Actions - Team CRUD operations
Generation Server Actions - Generation/Discord role mapping management
OAuth Client Admin REST API - CRUD for OAuth client applications
User Consent Revocation API - REST endpoint for revoking OAuth app consents
Auth Callback Handler - Discord OAuth callback, session exchange, oauth_redirect cookie restoration
CI/CD Backup Workflow - Daily PostgreSQL pg_dump at 02:00 JST, GPG AES256 encryption, push to backup repo, 7-day retention
README - NextJS starter in Firebase Studio (minimal)
